Alex — great to connect earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery so we have a working MAP to iterate on. I attached a first-pass MAP (OpenWave_MAP_v1.xlsx) with suggested milestones, owners, and dependencies. Major points below: 

- Target close: 2026-09-02 (quarterly close aligned with your FYQ3 planning) — flexible if you need more time.
- Key milestones (high level):
  1) Procurement sign-off (PO or contract) — target 8/18/2026
  2) Security review & evidence exchange — target 7/30/2026
  3) Pilot integration (eng spike & sandbox) — target 8/10/2026
  4) Pilot evaluation & success criteria — target 8/25/2026
- Proposed customer RACI (customer side):
  - Economic buyer: Alex Taylor (confirmed during call)
  - Security owner: Priya Shah (needs to confirm)
  - Legal owner: Elena Ruiz (procurement/legal loop)
  - Eng lead: your staff engineer for integrations (please name)

Requests / asks for this thread:
1) Please confirm or correct the customer-side owners above.
2) If you have an internal target for procurement timeline, share here so we can align Redwood timelines.
3) Any must-have compliance docs beyond SOC 2 + architecture diagram? We attached SLA notes in PDF.

Next meeting: I propose a 30-min check on July 21 to align on RACI and procurement steps. If that works please send a calendar invite and include Priya + Elena.

Attachments:
- OpenWave_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- OpenWave_MAP_SLA_notes.pdf (summary of proposed SLAs and support turnaround)

Thanks — looking forward to the confirms so we can lock dates and owners into the MAP.
